= loginWithPassword

[.signature]
[subs="normal"]
----
client.loginWithPassword(
  <<email>>: String? = null,
  <<phoneNumber>>: String? = null,
  <<customIdentifier>>: String? = null,
  <<password>>: String,
  <<scope>>: Collection<String> = defaultScope,
  <<origin>>: String? = null,

== About this command

Authenticate the user with the specified identifier (email, phone number, or custom identifier) and password.

A user may identify themselves with either their email address or their phone number if the SMS feature is enabled.

== Parameters

[.options]
[cols="1,3a"]
|===
|[[email, email]]email `String?` (optional) | Email address of the profile. Mutually exclusive with `phoneNumber` and `customIdentifier`.
|[[phoneNumber, phoneNumber]]phoneNumber `String?` (optional) | Phone number of the profile. Mutually exclusive with `email` and `customIdentifier`.
|[[customIdentifier, customIdentifier]]customIdentifier `String?` (optional) | Custom identifier of the profile. Mutually exclusive with `email` and `phoneNumber`.
|[[password, password]]password `String` | Password of the profile.
|[[scope, scope]]scope `Collection<String>` (optional) | List of space-delimited, case-sensitive strings representing the requested scope.
|[[origin, origin]]origin `String?` (optional) | Free-text parameter describing the source of the event (reporting only).
|[[mfaConf, mfaConf]]mfaConf `LoginMfaConf?` (optional) | MFA continuation configuration. Required when the login must continue into a step-up flow.

[cols="1,3a"]
!===
![[LoginMfaConf-activity, activity]]activity `Activity` ! The Android activity used to continue the MFA step-up flow.
![[LoginMfaConf-redirectUri, redirectUri]]redirectUri `String?` (optional) ! Optional redirect URI for the step-up continuation.

Deprecated:: redirectUri will be removed in a future release
!===
|[[success, success]]success `Success<AuthToken>` | Callback invoked when login succeeds. Receives an `AuthToken`.
|[[failure, failure]]failure `Failure<ReachFiveError>` | Callback invoked when login fails. Receives a `ReachFiveError`.
|===

== Response

The `success` callback receives <<AuthToken>>.
